column2: The wicked problem of AI and assessment
column6: "Reframes generative AI in higher-ed assessment as a 'wicked problem' with no single correct solution — arguing educators need institutional permission to compromise, diverge, and iterate rather than searching for a silver bullet."
"A practical guide for K-12 educators built on the principle that pedagogy comes first and AI second; includes rubrics, templates, and reflection questions for planning AI-integrated lessons."

column2: The Thinking Problem: Science of Learning Solution for AI in Schools
column6: "Argues that AI's central risk in schools is doing students' thinking for them, and applies cognitive-science principles to design AI use that requires deep cognitive engagement rather than replacing it."

column2: Powerful Teaching: Unleash the Science of Learning
column6: "A research-grounded guide for K-12 educators built around four evidence-based strategies — retrieval practice, spacing, interleaving, and feedback-driven metacognition — drawn from a 15-year scientist-teacher collaboration."

column2: Smart Teaching Stronger Learning: Practical Tips from 10 Cognitive Scientists
column6: "A short, accessible book in which ten cognitive scientists who are also classroom teachers each share an evidence-based teaching strategy across ten 10-page chapters covering retrieval practice, interleaving, metacognition, motivation, and more."

column2: Make It Stick: The Science of Successful Learning
column6: "The flagship popular book on the cognitive science of effective learning — debunking common study myths like rereading and cramming, and presenting evidence-based strategies including spaced practice, retrieval, and interleaving."
